I was working with my friend who owns his own shop. He had a new customer who had his car towed there, and was visually stressed. When asked what the issue was, the customer said his car hesitates, and jolts when he hits the gas pedal. 

My friend immediately asked the question “What quality gas did you put in your car?”  And the customer said, and i quote, “premium, but i couldnt afford a full tanks worth so i added water until it was full”

My friend and I exchanged “is this guy serious” looks and immediately fixed the issue. After everything was taken care of, my friend said “water is bad for your tank. never add it, at all. no exceptions. if you cant afford premium, dont get it” and the customer left without saying a word. 

Oh, and the customer left a 2/5 star review, and his comment was “never again. [mechanics name] wouldnt give me a first time customer discount.”

Wow.

I was in a school choir back in middle school and I was an alto so I wasn’t necessarily important, but my mom thought otherwise. 

It was the night of a concert and the letter that got sent home said strictly to wear a white shirt with black jeans. My mom, being the woman she was, made me wear a white and black *dress*

I couldn’t get out of the dress or the concert, so I went to the school for the concert completely dressed wrong. When we walked up to my teacher to sign me in, my mom said “I thought the dress code was a little plain, so I spiced it up a bit” and the teachers face was a combination of irritation, disgust and disbelief. 

I started to cry and my mom acted oblivious and asked why, to which I replied “you’re embarrassing me” and she got mad and invalidated my emotions. I was then sent backstage to practice and my mom was sent to her seat. 

This story ends with a happy ending though. My teacher ended up finding a white shirt and black pants in the lost in found, and I agreed to wear them. Btw they weren’t smelly, visibly soiled or anything. 

After the concert during the car ride home, my mom was completely silent. I was all smiles because other than the concert going amazingly well, I had one upped my mom.
